name: badge
summary: Renders a compact status or category with visible text, semantic tone, and an optional decorative icon.

agent.useWhen: A short state or category must remain visible beside its subject. Choose a semantic tone; a matching decorative icon is included by default for non-neutral tones.
agent.avoidWhen: The message needs a sentence, recovery action, live announcement, or interactive behavior.

invariants: Configuration supplies tone and decorative icon options; the visible label is app-owned presentation data, currently literal-only in Native declarations.
The component owns no browser-local state, events, commands or patch lifecycle; it composes beside the app-owned subject and is replaced as ordinary server-rendered content.
A visible nonblank label is always present and status remains understandable without color.
Badges are static, noninteractive content and do not announce changes.
Icons are decorative; the badge label carries the meaning.
An omitted icon selects the tone's semantic default (none for neutral); showIcon=false removes it and a named icon must exist in the package icons.json catalog.
The adapter validates exactly one [[attributes]], [[icon]], and [[label]] slot and expands checked attributes, icon markup, and escaped label text.
